full_judgment: 19. From exhibit-Ka and Ka-1, the original registered deeds dated 6-2-1970; it appears that Makhani Bewa transferred the suit land for legal necessity of the minor. The plaintiff failed to rebut the presumption as to the contents of the aforesaid deeds by adducing cogent reliable evidence; therefore, it cannot be held that the transfer made by Makhani Bewa was illegal. But unfortunately, the learned Judge of the Appellate Court without considering the intricate question of law involved in this case most illegally decreed the suit by gratuitous findings; therefore, the same is liable to be struck down.
